why: The FKT line climbs Aasgard Pass from Colchuck Lake and then the east-face snowfield to the summit, which is our East Route as written; Lemke Climbs, The Mountaineers and The Outbound describe that same standard line.
FKT car-to-car follows the Mount Si trail up to the Haystack, the same as WTA's description of our trail route.
The FKT page says its report is for the AA Col route, and guides list AA Col as a distinct west-side route to the summit, matching our AA Col.
FKT page titles the line Northwest Ridge car-to-car and Wikipedia names the Northwest Arete as the peak classic route, matching our only route.

FKT line is the trailhead-to-summit-and-back from the Wedgemount Lake trail, using the NE Arete (bypass up, normal ridge down); Wikipedia calls the Northeast Arete the direct route from Wedgemount Lake.
The FKT page and two trail write-ups agree on the Packer Lake Road trail up the PCT and old jeep road to the stair-topped lookout, matching our trail.
The FKT line is the Hurd, Peak 12,192, Trapezoid, Mt Johnson link-up from South Lake that Mountain Project describes as the South Lake Peaks Traverse.
Out-and-back up Granite Chief Trail to the PCT, then PCT to the pass just southeast of the peak and a short use-trail to the summit, matching our route text.

trailhead.name: Granite Chief Trail trailhead, Olympic Valley

why: Barcroft Gate to summit by the South Slopes road, the standard Class 1 route, out-and-back per the independent guide.
FKT page and Climb13ers both describe the East Ridge via Hope Pass from Sheep Gulch, matching our route; Difficult Class 2 on both.
FKT Fourmile Creek route follows the saddle then the southwest ridge, which 14ers.com gives as the standard Class 1 Southwest Ridge.
FKT entry is the North Spur out and back from Hoosier Pass, and a 14ers.com trip report describes the same Hoosier Ridge to North Spur line.
FKT page names the standard Guanella Pass route and links 14ers.com, whose West Slopes page describes the same willows-to-shoulder-to-ridge line our route lists.
FKT out-and-back from the 2WD trailhead matches the 14ers.com standard East Slopes route via Tigger ridge.
